subject: Renewal + Capacity Uplift: order form and MSA updates
messages:
From: Sarah Bennett <sarah@allieddata.com>
To: michael.grant@redwood.com
Cc: Tony Lane <tony.lane@allieddata.com>
Date: 2027-06-12T09:32:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal + capacity increase — next steps

Hi Michael,

We’re moving forward with the 12‑month renewal but need to increase committed capacity across our production pools — roughly a 35% uplift from current baseline (see internal note attached). Procurement asked me to get an updated order form and any MSA changes up front so we can circulate to our legal and procurement teams.

Can you send:
- a clean order form (with the new tiers + pricing)
- a redline of any MSA language that will change (auto‑renew, data retention, SLA credits)
- a target timeline for signature (our renewal hits end of month if possible)

Tony from our ops team is looped for technical sizing. We may also request a short playbook for ramping the extra capacity.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

Best,
Sarah Bennett
Head of Platform Engineering
Allied Data Systems
[Attachment: AlliedData_internal_capacity_note.pdf (pdf)]

From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Bennett <sarah@allieddata.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com, neha.kapoor@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: 2027-06-12T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity increase — next steps

Sarah — thanks for the note and the head‑start. We can accommodate the +35% uplift; I’ve attached a proposed order form that reflects the new committed tiers and a preliminary MSA redline from our side.

Quick plan:
1) Marissa (legal) to review and call out any problematic clauses — particularly around auto‑renew term, liability cap, and data retention.
2) Ben (sales ops) to validate pricing math and update invoice schedule.
3) Neha (renewals) to prepare the renewal playbook (ramp timeline, support touchpoints).

We’re targeting signature by 2027‑06‑30 to avoid any service gap. If procurement needs the redlines in track‑changes Word, say so and I’ll ask Legal to drop a Word version.

Attachments: AlliedData_proposed_orderform_v2.docx; redwood_MSA_redlines_Marissa_20270613.pdf

I’ll leave initial legal comments to Marissa.

—Mike
Michael Grant

Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: michael.grant@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com, neha.kapoor@redwood.com
Date: 2027-06-13T08:20:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Renewal + capacity increase — next steps (MSA redlines)

Mike / team — I reviewed the draft MSA redlines and summarized below. Please consider these high‑priority asks from Allied’s side and our proposed responses. Inline redline PDF attached (see comments).

Allied asks and my recommendations:
- Auto‑renew term: Allied wants a 12‑month auto‑renew with 30‑day opt‑out; we should retain our 60‑day notice but can offer a one‑time exception for this renewal since they’re expanding.
- Liability cap: Allied proposes unlimited liability for data incidents for the expanded capacity window. We cannot accept unlimited liability. Propose tying cap to 3x average monthly spend or carve out for proven gross negligence.
- Data retention & deletion: Allied requests 90‑day backup retention and quarterly evidence of deletion. We can agree to 90‑day retention but will provide a quarterly attestation, not raw logs. For contractual audit rights, limit to SOC2 evidence and a redacted sample export.
- SLA credits: Allied requests credits for any degradation below 99.5%. Our standard is 99.8% for dedicated pools; propose a blended credit schedule for the uplift months (first 3 months ramp = 99.5% target then 99.8% thereafter).

Deliverables I will produce:
- Word track‑changes of the MSA for procurement (if procurement insists on Word).
- Clean MSA redline summary with alternative language (to speed negotiations).

Ben — confirm the pricing rows for the +35% tiers in the attached order form (I left placeholders for any volume discounts). Neha — can you draft the 90‑day ramp playbook?

Attachments: redwood_MSA_redlines_Marissa_20270613.pdf (redline comments); will follow with Word track changes if needed.

Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Commercial
Redwood Inference

From: Sarah Bennett <sarah@allieddata.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com, michael.grant@redwood.com
Cc: Tony Lane <tony.lane@allieddata.com>, procurement@allieddata.com
Date: 2027-06-14T14:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity increase — next steps

Marissa — thanks for the quick read. A few immediate follow ups from procurement/legal:
1) On liability: procurement will not accept 3x monthly spend as a hard cap without insurance confirmation. Could we offer a limited carve‑out for data breach remediation costs (not punitive damages) and keep the cap at 6x monthly spend for the expanded capacity portion?
2) For SLA: the blended schedule is acceptable if there's an explicit ramp plan and a one‑time onboarding credit for the first month.
3) Doc format: procurement asked for Word track changes for the MSA redline.

Can you send the Word track changes and a clean order form with the 6x cap option toggled so procurement can review side‑by‑side? Also, please provide a proposed DocuSign packet so our procurement team can circulate quickly — they prefer eSign.

If you can get DocuSign + Word redlines by EOD tomorrow, I’ll push internally for signoff.

Thanks —
Sarah
Head of Platform Engineering, Allied Data Systems
[Procurement contact: procurement@allieddata.com]

From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Bennett <sarah@allieddata.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com, neha.kapoor@redwood.com
Date: 2027-06-15T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity increase — next steps

Sarah — appreciate the quick turn. Attached: Word track changes of the MSA (Marissa has accepted to produce with alternate language for both 3x and 6x caps), a clean order form with two pricing scenarios (standard 3x‑cap and optional 6x‑cap with an insurance desk note), and a DocuSign packet prepared for signature.

Next steps:
- If procurement prefers the 6x cap checkbox, we can include that as an optional Exhibit and route the DocuSign packet to procurement@allieddata.com + Tony.
- Neha will follow up with the ramp playbook and a proposed onboarding credit (one month) to be reflected on the invoice schedule.
- If procurement confirms by COB 2027‑06‑17 we’ll hit the internal approvals and route for signature by 2027‑06‑24 to meet program timelines.

Attachments: docusign-AlliedData-2027-06.pdf; redwood_MSA_redlines_Marissa_20270613.docx; AlliedData_proposed_orderform_v2.docx
